reason: Conversation 1 correctly identified the hidden truth (humidity already below target plus a cold garage means the compressor idles and no water is collected), asked exactly the right unknowns (model, reading vs target, temperature, codes), suggested a safe warm-room test rather than opening the unit, and pointed to Meaco support only if that test failed, with no unjustified part recommendation. Its only shortfall was not stating that dehumidifiers are outside the service's scope. Conversation 2 was a broken loop that repeated the same two canned questions, ignored every fact the customer supplied, never diagnosed anything, and left the homeowner with nothing.
